data.narrative: Completed Module 5 'Ticket Writing' learning about the 7-section ticket format (Title, Context, Scope, Interface Contract, Acceptance Criteria, Constraints, Anti-Scope), prescriptive vs intent tickets, distinguishing spec gaps from implementation decisions, and identifying unstated assumptions in security, operational, data, and integration categories.

dimension_scores.observation: Created 6 tickets using 7-section format with complete interface contracts including request/response bodies, status codes, and database schemas
dimension_scores.evidence: artifacts/tickets-module-05.md contains 6 tickets with full interface contracts

dimension_scores.observation: Tickets build on each other logically - Ticket 1 seeds data for Tickets 2 and 3, Ticket 4 booking depends on Ticket 2 providers, Tickets 5 and 6 auth are independent
dimension_scores.evidence: Ticket dependencies reflect slice dependencies from Module 4

dimension_scores.observation: Identified security and operational gaps through AI agent roleplay (no auth, no rate limiting, generic error handling, no logging) and fixed all tickets with explicit constraints
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_verification.md and module5_fix.md document gap identification and fixes

dimension_scores.observation: All tickets use 7-section format with Given/When/Then acceptance criteria, explicit interface contracts showing exact JSON shapes, and detailed constraints
dimension_scores.evidence: Every ticket has Title, Context, Scope, Interface Contract, Acceptance Criteria, Constraints, Anti-Scope

dimension_scores.observation: Responded to AI agent roleplay feedback by immediately identifying spec gaps and applying fixes to all 6 tickets, adding rate limiting, logging, error handling, and security constraints
dimension_scores.evidence: Updated all tickets in tickets-module-05.md with operational and security constraints

dimension_scores.observation: Identified that ticket outputs must match next ticket inputs (booking_id format consistency) and added validation to ensure data integrity across tickets
dimension_scores.evidence: module5_fix.md completeness checklist notes need to verify booking_id format consistency
